lead: I'm a Python and C++ software engineer in Vancouver with 6.5+ years of experience.
body: I've worked across Python, C++, C#, machine learning, cloud, and big data (Hadoop, SQL, Spark). Most of my work is building algorithms and applications that hold up at scale, with good tests.

At Microsoft I'm a Technical Lead. I write ARM silicon firmware (SystemC, C, C++), automate FPGA and silicon validation in Python and C++, and lead automation and SoC validation across four projects, including standardizing our Azure DevOps pipelines and leading a team of four. Before that I was at Intel (PCIe / CXL modelling), Evenant and Algolys (full stack), and Bosch (sensor testing and ML for MEMS).
I studied Applied Science at UBC (2015-2018). Outside work I make Unity games like Level and The Arena, maintain an open-source ML project (MFS), and write music for games.
